GSE182158.publication: Single-cell transcriptome atlas of human mesenchymal stem cells exploring cellular heterogeneity
GSE182158.tissue_source: dermis, bone marrow, umbilical cord, adipose
GSE182158.exact_biological_material: flow-sorted early-passage cultured MSCs from 11 donors; U01/U02 are umbilical-cord MSC donors
GSE182158.maternal_age: NOT_APPLICABLE; donor ages: A01 38, A02 46, A03 32, B01 33, B02 43, B03 27, D01 33, D02 28, D03 22, U01 28, U02 37 years
GSE182158.fetal_sex: NOT_APPLICABLE; donor sex: A01 F, A02 F, A03 F, B01 M, B02 M, B03 F, D01 M, D02 M, D03 M, U01 F, U02 F

Downloaded barcode files contain U01=12,740 and U02=9,861 matrix columns (22,601 pre-QC); paper reports 21,232 post-QC umbilical-cord cells. Platform NovaSeq 6000, Chromium 3' v2, Cell Ranger 2.1.0.

Paper states 202 untreated and 159 stimulated and overall design states D1 stimulated 59, D2 P5 naive 50. Difference is UNRESOLVED; no cell was reassigned.
